limitations: System spectra do not by themselves establish resolved Aa/Ab observations.
Reported phase is retained without recomputation from RV fit periods.
JD(obs) and HJD labels are retained; no UTC equivalence is assumed.
2013 mean 6025 plus/minus 1 K uses standard error of the mean, not total error.
The 2013 99 pc distance and pulsation-mode interpretation are not merged with the 2024 distance chain.
